title: Chinese Roasted Comte Pilaf
description: A twist on traditional pilaf, this Chinese-inspired dish combines roasted Comte cheese with Mediterranean flavors.
instructions: Rinse the pilaf rice and cook according to package instructions.
In a separate pan, heat the olive oil and add the Chinese five-spice.
Add the soy sauce and stir to combine.
Add the cooked pilaf rice to the pan and stir to coat with the soy sauce mixture.
Transfer the pilaf to a baking dish and top with the roasted Comte cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven for 5-7 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and top with Mediterranean olives.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
